text:
Maria Gonzales: Quick sync — CloudMarket x VoltEdge joint webinar planned for 2024-05-14. Need: final speaker list, demo owners, run-of-show, and swag shipping cutoff.
Owen Patel: I can own the low-latency chat demo. Will prepare perf numbers.
Jin Park: I'll own the model-swap demo and fallback path. Need to confirm we have 2 demo units + spare.
Sarah Lee: Marketing: we need co-marketing assets + marketplace tile copy. Also a registrant cap? recommend 500.
Asha (VoltEdge): We can ship 10 demo units (9 + 1 spare). ETA to SF office by 2024-05-10 if you give final list by 2024-04-28.
Maria Gonzales: Perfect. Can someone volunteer to coordinate swag returns?
Sarah Lee: I will. Shipping deadline for branded swag (stickers + mini-branded power banks) is 2024-05-01 to meet handout SLA.
Owen Patel: Slide asks: include a 1-slide TL;DR on latency/cost delta. I'll draft.
Jin Park: Hardware fallback plan — if VoltEdge box fails, we demo hosted Redwood instance and show the route policy. Need an infra runbook.
Maria Gonzales: Dry-run options: Tue 2024-05-07 15:00 PT or Thu 2024-04-30 10:00 PT. Which works for partners?
Asha (VoltEdge): 05-07 15:00 PT works. Will have onsite engineer on that call.
dev-rel-bot: Created calendar event: "CloudMarket x VoltEdge — dry run" on 2024-05-07 15:00 PT and invited participants.
Jin Park: Run-of-show draft:
```
10:00 AM - Host intro (Maria)
10:05 AM - Partner keynote (Asha)
10:15 AM - Demo 1: Low-latency chat (Owen) — show 95p latency
10:30 AM - Demo 2: Model swap + autoscaling (Jin) — fallback to hosted if hw down
10:45 AM - Short product Q&A
11:00 AM - Close / CTA to marketplace tile
```
Owen Patel: Suggest we build a one-click marketplace CTA slide linking to the deployment SKU. Sarah can we get a short landing URL?
Sarah Lee: Yes — marketing will create a short link + co-branded landing. Need partner logo SVG by EOD 2024-04-25. Also will prepare press blurb for marketplace launch synced to webinar.
Asha (VoltEdge): Uploading logos + engineer contact to the shared folder now. Also can provide a 30s recorded demo clip if we want to autoplay during a portion.
Maria Gonzales: Action list:
- Owen: slide + perf numbers (due 2024-04-29)
- Jin: infra runbook + fallback plan (due 2024-05-03)
- Sarah: landing URL + swag plan + press blurb (due 2024-05-01)
- Asha: shipment manifest + logos + engineer contact (due 2024-04-28)
- Maria: finalize registrant page + send invites (done after assets)
Jin Park: Quick note for on-site team: ssh key for demo nodes -> add `deploy@redwood-demo` to authorized_keys, and set up a simple health-check script: `curl -fsS localhost:8080/health || echo FAIL`.
Owen Patel: We'll also include a tiny dashboard screenshot showing token cost per 1k reqs — keeps buyer attention on economics.
Sarah Lee: Swag details: 500 sticker packs + 150 power banks + 50 mini plush GPUs for giveaways. We need address matrix from partners by 2024-05-01 for customs forms.
Asha (VoltEdge): Confirmed — will provide customs-friendly packing list and HS codes.
Maria Gonzales: Legal check — any co-announcement NDA or embargo? Sarah, please loop legal if needed.
Sarah Lee: Looping legal now. Also attaching brand guidelines to the shared folder once logos arrive.
Maria Gonzales: Awesome, thanks everyone. I'll update the shared doc with run-of-show and actions. :thumbsup:
